authoring.basis: Blender Z-up, origin at cell centre
authoring.mountPlane: z = 0 (bracket / tray feet sit on the mount)
authoring.export: glTF Y-up (Blender +Z -> glTF +Y, Blender +Y -> glTF -Z, Blender +X -> glTF +X)
authoring.runtimeSeat: works renderer rotates Y-up authored places +90 deg around X so the pad faces +Z

1.name: N
1.note: renderer dy = -dr so N draws toward +Y in three.js overlay space

topologyMap.2-bit-opposite: straight (rotate so ports match the axis)
topologyMap.2-bit-adjacent: corner (rotate so the two ports match the bits)
topologyMap.serviceNode: junction (3+ meetings, or an explicit service box)

portFace.rule: Every port of a family shares one YZ (or XZ) section at the cell face. Adjacent cells meet at the shared face; no overlap, no gap.

lane.note: Cycle 04: every LOD and all six modular port faces share the 1.10 wu outer envelope. Belt width remains interior, while rails, rollers, throat clearances, service enclosure and supports are reauthored to that section.

floorToWall.rule: Local +Z is always away from the mount. Identity is floor. Wall: rotate +90 deg around the run axis so +Z points into the tunnel.

hooks.power: powered — recessed contact slot / gland window, never the jacket
hooks.lane: flow_mesh — belt or chain riding the rollers; U along travel for UV scroll
